gap.missing_evidence: Inspected sources do not provide a dated ED register separating nominal bays, open/staffed/monitored/equipped/compatible capacity, closures and surge spaces.
gap.impact: METEOR field is an averaged overnight admitted-care bed count and excludes predominantly non-admitted emergency trolleys. Its staffing/closure examples explain availability but are not observed ED values. At-a-glance public hospital annual average and 24-hour ED facility description do not identify usable ED beds. No numeric capacity or calendar default accepted.
